 Shawn Michaels Celebrates Cruz Montana’s WWE Raw Debut 
 Skylar Russell November 2, 2026, 9:58 pm 
 Facebook 
 X 
 Bluesky 
 Shawn Michaels celebrates Cruz Montana. 
 This week’s episode of WWE Raw ended with a big main roster call up, as Cruz Montana made the jump and joined The 946 in the process. 
 Taking to social media after the conclusion of Raw, Shawn Michaels commented on Montana’s transition, touting the recent success of NXT in the process. 
 “Another one moving on up! Congratulations to @Montana_NYPR on making the jump to the main roster! That’s 19 NXT Superstars making the leap to Raw and SmackDown in the last 12 months. Pretty proud of that number, but even prouder of the talent and crew who make it happen. Keep showing the world what #WWENXT is all about! See the future of WWE this week on Wednesday night at 8/7c on @TheCW and the @espn Unlimited app” 
 Another one moving on up! 👏
 Congratulations to @Montana_NYPR on making the jump to the main roster!
 That’s 19 NXT Superstars making the leap to Raw and SmackDown in the last 12 months. Pretty proud of that number, but even prouder of the talent and crew who make it happen.… https://t.co/0FwdzAAXvT
